title: Adapting to the times and ambition (Irving Ashby)
summary: Some players adapt to new tunes and some lack ambition or have enough money; Bunn still wanted to keep working.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant
